tagline: Aromatic Herbal Excellence for Food Manufacturing
overview: TradeNest Naturals manufactures and exports dehydrated rosemary leaves from India for commercial food production. Sourced from selected rosemary foliage, the leaves undergo careful cleaning, sorting, and controlled drying to retain their characteristic herbal aroma and pine-like flavor. With moisture levels maintained at or below 8 percent, our product provides long-term stability and consistent quality for food processors and seasoning formulators worldwide.

Operating as an FSSAI-registered supplier and IEC-registered exporter, we offer complete bulk supply alongside OEM and private-label programs. Our standardized 6-step manufacturing process covers sourcing, drying, sieving, and quality inspection before packing. We support international buyers with export documentation, samples on request, flexible packaging formats, and custom mesh sizes tailored to specific industrial recipes and seasoning blends.
highlights: Standard 10-20 mesh cut leaf with customized particle sizing available
Moisture content strictly maintained at or below 8 percent
Distinctive pine-like aroma with a warm, woody herbal flavor profile
Free from added colors, artificial preservatives, and fillers
Shelf life of 24 months under cool, dry storage conditions
Minimum 98 percent purity achieved through controlled sorting and sieving
applications: Pizza, pasta, and dry Italian seasoning mixes
Marinades, gravies, soups, and savory sauces
Roasted vegetable and potato seasoning preparations
Savory bakery items, crackers, and bread doughs
Meat, poultry, seafood, and plant-based protein formulations
Foodservice culinary blending and restaurant prep systems
industries: Prepared meal and convenience food producers
packaging: Small private-label pouches and PET jars

faqs.q: What is the minimum order quantity for dehydrated rosemary leaves?
faqs.a: Our minimum order quantity starts at 5 kg, accommodating pilot blending trials as well as large-scale industrial bulk supply.

faqs.q: What mesh sizes and cuts are available?
faqs.a: We provide standard 10-20 mesh for cut leaves, along with whole leaf, coarse cut, and 40-60 mesh fine material upon request.
We follow a 6-step production process encompassing sourcing, cleaning and sorting, controlled drying, grinding and sieving, quality inspection, and packing and dispatch.

faqs.q: Can you accommodate OEM and private-label packaging?
faqs.a: Yes, we support OEM and private-label programs with customized packaging options ranging from 25 kg bulk bags to retail-ready pouches and jars.

faqs.q: Are product samples provided before bulk ordering?
faqs.a: Samples are available on request to help buyers assess leaf appearance, mesh size, moisture level, and aroma prior to placing commercial orders.

faqs.q: What export support does TradeNest Naturals provide?
faqs.a: As an IEC-registered exporter and FSSAI-registered supplier, we provide complete export documentation support, batch traceability, and secure international packing.
